# Test Fixtures

This directory contains test fixtures for GMNAP v7.0 testing.

## v7.0 Specification Requirement
The v7.0 specifications call for 1500 test fixtures to ensure comprehensive test coverage across all region groups and processing scenarios.

## Current Status
- **Required**: 1500 fixtures (per v7.0 spec)
- **Current**: Limited fixtures available
- **TODO**: Generate or import remaining fixtures

## Structure
- `regions/` - Region-specific test fixtures

## Fixture Types Needed
- Name samples for each region group (A1-A5, B1-B3, C1-C9, etc.)
- Edge cases and boundary conditions
- Unicode and special character test cases
- Multi-script name samples
- Authority source test data
